trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Collect luggage and take the Ramada Kissimmee Gateway free theme park shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to the hotel. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your Disney World park tickets and plans for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour Denny's (~1 mile from hotel) or pick up snacks at a nearby Walmart Neighborhood Market on W Irlo Bronson Hwy to stock up for the week

day_by_day.notes: Pro tip: Stop at Walmart or Publix near the hotel tonight or first thing tomorrow to stock up on breakfast items, snacks, and drinks to save significantly on in-park food costs. The hotel offers free shuttle service to Disney parks — confirm the shuttle schedule at the front desk upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom (confirm shuttle time at front desk — typically departs 8:00–8:30 AM). Arrive early for rope drop around 9:00 AM. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and TRON Lightcycle Run (use Lightning Lane if budget allows). Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion before crowds build. Grab a free Disney park map and plan your Lightning Lane selections wisely.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland — ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (grab a Lightning Lane reservation early via app), Peter Pan's Flight, and It's a Small World. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check times in the app). Take a mid-afternoon break at a shaded area or the hotel if needed to avoid peak heat and crowds.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the Main Street Electrical Parade and the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically around 9:00 PM). Take the free hotel shuttle back after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the hotel or from groceries purchased the night before to save money
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with clam chowder, fish & chips, and sandwiches (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of the best value counter-service spots in Magic Kingdom with burgers, chicken, and rotisserie options (~$13-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — prioritize it early in the trip when energy is highest. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times and grab Lightning Lane selections for top rides. Bring a refillable water bottle; free water is available at any quick-service location. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+).

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane — set an alarm for 7:00 AM to grab a boarding group via the app). Then ride Test Track and Soarin' Around the World before lines grow. Explore Future World/World Discovery and World Nature pavilions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the World Showcase — walk through Mexico, Norway (ride Frozen Ever After), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Enjoy the cultural exhibits, street performers, and unique architecture. Check the app for any live entertainment or cultural performances.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's stunning EPCOT Forever or Luminous: The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule). Browse the World Showcase shops for affordable souvenirs. Take the hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast from grocery supplies
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — excellent value with rotating seasonal dishes, sandwiches, and salads (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie in the France pavilion — grab a croque monsieur, quiche, or French pastry for a budget-friendly and delicious dinner (~$10-14 per person)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a walking-heavy park — comfortable shoes are essential. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World rides. Many World Showcase pavilions offer free cultural experiences and entertainment. Avoid purchasing alcohol in the park to keep costs down — it's significantly marked up.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Rush to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Rise of the Resistance first (Lightning Lane highly recommended — book at 7:00 AM via app) then Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the immersive Galaxy's Edge land and browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then experience Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Hollywood Boulevard area. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times). Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat hours (2–4 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Return for the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show — one of the best nighttime shows at Disney World (check current schedule). Also catch the Fantasmic! show if running (check app for showtimes — arrive 30–45 minutes early for good seats). Take the hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun theming with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos at reasonable prices (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — one of the most budget-friendly counter-service spots in Hollywood Studios with burgers, wraps, and flatbreads (~$12-15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios has the most in-demand Lightning Lane attractions at Disney World — prioritize Rise of the Resistance and Slinky Dog Dash. The park can feel crowded in the evening due to nighttime shows, so plan accordingly. Galaxy's Edge merchandise (like building your own lightsaber or droid) is expensive — budget separately if interested (~$50-220).

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom often opens early). Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar: ride Avatar Flight of Passage first (Lightning Lane strongly recommended — book at 7:00 AM) then Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent beauty of Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (go in the morning or late afternoon for best animal activity). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — plan accordingly). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (check current schedule — Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks, typically 8–9 PM). Enjoy the Finding Nemo: The Big Blue... and Beyond! show at the Theater in the Wild. Take the hotel shuttle back and enjoy a relaxing evening.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — eat before the park to maximize morning ride time
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of the best value and most scenic counter-service restaurants at Disney World with ribs, pulled pork, and chicken (~$14-17 per person)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — excellent value with customizable bowls featuring grains, proteins, and unique sauces (~$14-17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning and late afternoon — animals are most active during cooler parts of the day. The park is very walking-intensive with lots of outdoor trails. Bring bug spray for the evening hours. Kali River Rapids will soak you — bring a change of clothes or a poncho (~$10 in park or bring your own from home).

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning at the hotel. Have a leisurely breakfast from your grocery supplies. Take a dip in the hotel pool to recharge after four intense park days. Review photos and memories from the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take the free hotel shuttle or a short rideshare (~$10-15) to Disney Springs — Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world) for last-minute souvenirs. Visit the LEGO Store, check out the outdoor entertainment, and enjoy the waterfront atmosphere.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and entertainment at Disney Springs. Watch street performers and live music (free). If budget allows, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes bowling alley. Take the shuttle back to the hotel and pack for checkout.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast from grocery supplies
meals.lunch: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — Guy Fieri's fast-casual chicken tender restaurant with great value (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs — craft BBQ with smoked meats, creative sides, and craft cocktails at reasonable prices (~$15-20 per person), or grab food from the food trucks for a more budget-friendly option (~$10-13)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter — no park ticket required. It's a great way to experience Disney magic without spending on park admission. Parking is also free. This is the perfect day to buy any remaining souvenirs, as prices at Disney Springs are sometimes slightly lower than in-park shops. The area gets very crowded on Saturday evenings — arrive by 3–4 PM for the best experience.

day_by_day.morning: Check out of the Ramada Kissimmee Gateway. Store luggage at the hotel front desk if your flight is later in the day. If time permits before departure, visit the nearby Old Town Kissimmee (free admission, just a short drive/rideshare from the hotel) — a retro-themed entertainment complex with free walking, shops, and weekend car shows. Alternatively, visit the nearby Icon Park on International Drive for free outdoor exploration (individual attractions are paid).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight time, head to Orlando International Airport via rideshare (~$25-35) or pre-arranged shuttle. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before departure for check-in, security, and boarding. Browse airport shops for any last-minute Florida souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando — reflect on an amazing week of Disney magic! Safe travels home.

meals.breakfast: Use up remaining hotel room grocery supplies or grab a quick breakfast at the hotel
meals.lunch: Grab lunch at a nearby Chick-fil-A, Subway, or McDonald's on W Irlo Bronson Hwy before heading to the airport (~$8-12 per person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport — look for Chick-fil-A, Burger King, or Subway in the terminal for budget-friendly options (~$10-15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Budget Summary for the Week: Park tickets are the biggest expense — look for multi-day discounted tickets through Undercover Tourist, AAA, or military discounts (can save $20-50+ per ticket). Estimated daily food budget: $30-45 per person by using hotel breakfast and smart counter-service choices. Total estimated trip cost per person (excluding flights): Park tickets (~$400-500 for 4-day ticket), hotel (~$70-100/night), food (~$250-300 for the week), extras (~$100-150). Grand total estimate: ~$800-1,100 per person for the week. Key savings tips: Free hotel shuttle saves ~$15-25/day in transportation; grocery store breakfast saves ~$15-20/day; refillable water bottle saves ~$5-10/day; avoiding Lightning Lane Individual purchases saves ~$15-25/day.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle or a rideshare to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review the week's park plans. Pick up any essentials at a nearby 24-hour Walmart or Walgreens on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby fast-food option near the hotel (McDonald's, Denny's, or IHOP on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy — all open late)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light. Set alarms early for Day 2. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done, link park tickets, and make any last-minute Lightning Lane reservations. Hydrate well after the flight — Florida summer heat can be intense.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Use the hotel's free theme park shuttle departing around 7:45–8:00 AM. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion using Lightning Lane or early morning low-wait windows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration — enjoy Pirates of the Caribbean, 'it's a small world,' and the Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Lightning Lane in advance). Take a midday break during peak heat (1–3 PM) at the air-conditioned Carousel of Progress or browse Main Street U.S.A. shops. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check daily schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom Happily Ever After Fireworks spectacular (typically 9:00 PM). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. 30–45 minutes early. Return to hotel via free shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the hotel or grab a pastry and coffee on Main Street U.S.A. at The Main Street Bakery (Starbucks-affiliated, mid-range pricing)
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — counter-service seafood and sandwiches, budget-friendly (~$15–$18 per person)
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland (book in advance) for a mid-range sit-down experience (~$25–$35 per person) OR Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn for affordable Tex-Mex counter service

day_by_day.notes: Book Lightning Lane Multi Pass for Space Mountain and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train as early as 7:00 AM on the app. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and a small fan or cooling towel. Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — pace yourself for a full day.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival. Head directly to Galaxy's Edge at park open. Join the virtual queue or walk-up queue for Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides). Then visit Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on piloting experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (~$249.99 — optional splurge, book in advance) or browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for Star Wars collectibles. Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania), and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check schedule — typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45 minutes early for good seats. Return to hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel continental breakfast or Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge for a themed breakfast experience (~$15–$20)
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge for a Ronto Wrap (~$14) — a fan favorite and great value
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — a unique drive-in movie themed restaurant with burgers, sandwiches, and salads (~$20–$30 per person, reservations recommended)

day_by_day.notes: Rise of the Resistance is extremely popular — check the My Disney Experience app the moment the park opens for boarding group availability. Lightsaber building at Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations and is a premium experience — decide in advance if it fits your budget. Bring ponchos — afternoon Florida thunderstorms are common in June.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Start in Future World (now called World Discovery/World Nature) and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane Individual) and Test Track. Then head to Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin the World Showcase loop around the lagoon. Sample authentic cuisines and explore pavilions: Mexico (La Cava del Tequila for a margarita or agua fresca), Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Enjoy street performers and cultural exhibits throughout. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule — typically 9:00 PM). Watch from the World Showcase promenade for the best views. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a quick stop at Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion at EPCOT (~$12–$16, counter service with fresh options)
meals.lunch: World Showcase food stalls — graze across multiple countries. Try a School Bread from Norway (~$6), a crepe from France (~$8), and a spring roll from China (~$6) for a fun, affordable multicultural lunch
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — hibachi-style teppanyaki dining, a memorable mid-range experience (~$30–$45 per person, reservations recommended) OR La Hacienda de San Angel in Mexico for lakeside dining with lagoon views

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the best park for foodies and culture lovers. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World rides. Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind requires a virtual queue or Lightning Lane Individual purchase — check the app at 7:00 AM. Comfortable walking shoes are essential as World Showcase is a 1.2-mile loop.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride — waits can exceed 2 hours by mid-morning). Use Lightning Lane if available. Then experience Na'vi River Journey for a gentler, visually stunning boat ride.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari — morning and early afternoon offer the best wildlife activity. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and more on a 20-minute open-air vehicle tour. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Then visit Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (expect to get wet — great for hot afternoons).
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show at dusk (check schedule). Enjoy the Rivers of Light nighttime show if available. Return to hotel via shuttle. Consider a relaxed evening at the hotel pool to rest tired feet.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at Harambe Market when it opens or bring a snack from the hotel for the early morning rush
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls and unique proteins (~$16–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia — Asian-fusion cuisine in a beautifully themed setting (~$20–$35 per person, reservations recommended) OR Flame Tree Barbecue for affordable outdoor BBQ with waterfront seating (~$15–$18)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (often 8:00–9:00 PM). Flight of Passage is the must-do — prioritize it at rope drop or book Lightning Lane Individual. Kali River Rapids will get you soaked — bring a change of clothes or wear quick-dry clothing. June heat is intense; the safari is best in the morning when animals are most active.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day — Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast. Head to Disney Springs mid-morning (free admission, no park ticket required). Explore the free entertainment, street performers, and unique shops. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and browse the eclectic mix of boutiques and galleries.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy Disney Springs' entertainment options: catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and billiards (~$15–$20 per person), or explore the Coca-Cola Store rooftop for complimentary beverage samples. Browse the Art of Disney gallery. This is also a great afternoon for souvenir shopping at mid-range price points.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed dinner at Disney Springs before returning to the hotel. Spend the evening at the hotel pool — a perfect way to recharge before the final park day. Review photos and memories from the week.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a nearby IHOP/Denny's on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy for a hearty, affordable sit-down meal (~$10–$15 per person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings (~$15–$18 per person) OR Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza for customizable personal pizzas (~$12–$15)
meals.dinner: The Boathouse at Disney Springs — upscale waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American fare (~$30–$50 per person). A mid-range splurge for a special evening, or opt for Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for a more budget-friendly option (~$12–$15)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to save on park ticket costs while still enjoying the Disney atmosphere. Parking is free in the Disney Springs garages. The hotel shuttle may not serve Disney Springs directly — check with the front desk or use a rideshare (~$10–$15 each way from Kissimmee). Saturday can be busy at Disney Springs — arrive before noon for easier navigation.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a favorite park or explore a missed experience — recommended: revisit Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any rides or experiences missed earlier in the week. Alternatively, use this morning for a final hotel pool session, last-minute souvenir shopping on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (International Drive area has many discount souvenir shops), or a relaxed breakfast before checkout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the hotel (standard checkout ~11:00 AM — request late checkout if needed). Store luggage with the front desk if your flight is later. If time allows, visit a nearby attraction: Fun Spot America Kissimmee (go-karts, roller coasters, ~$35–$45) or Old Town Kissimmee (free walking area with shops and weekend car shows). Head to the airport with ample time.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando. Reflect on an incredible week at Disney World. Enjoy airport dining at Orlando International Airport — try Vines Grille & Wine Bar or Cask & Larder for a sit-down farewell Florida meal before your flight.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast or a nearby favorite — First Watch on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy is a popular daytime café with fresh, mid-range breakfast options (~$12–$16 per person)
meals.lunch: Quick lunch at a park if visiting, or grab sandwiches and snacks from a nearby Publix supermarket for a budget-friendly pre-flight meal
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or an early dinner near the hotel before heading to the airport

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for the drive to MCO, bag drop, and security. The hotel shuttle to the airport may need to be pre-booked — confirm with the front desk the night before. Consider using Magical Express alternatives or a rideshare (~$25–$35 to MCO from Kissimmee). Leave room in your luggage for souvenirs purchased throughout the week!

Then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage ride. Explore the Pandora World of Avatar at dusk when the bioluminescent landscape glows beautifully.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora & Africa Sections, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight UA arrives at 22:30. No morning or afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit. Flight arrives late evening.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Use Ramada's complimentary theme park shuttle or arrange a private car transfer to the hotel. Check in to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Unwind with a late-night snack from the hotel's amenities or a nearby 24-hour convenience stop.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Late-night arrival – grab a light bite at the hotel or a nearby late-night spot such as Denny's (open 24 hrs, 2 min drive) or order room service if available

day_by_day.notes: Pack light carry-on essentials for easy late-night check-in. Confirm shuttle schedule with the hotel in advance or pre-book a private luxury car service (e.g., Mears Connect First Class or a private limo) for a seamless arrival. Get to bed early – big park days start tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~8:00 AM). Start with Tomorrowland: Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin. Move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane Multi Pass for priority access). Visit Cinderella Castle for photos and explore Liberty Square's Haunted Mansion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration – After lunch, head to Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Explore Frontierland's Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Lightning Lane Single Pass for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train if not done in the morning. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel (shuttle back) or relax in the park's shaded areas.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime shows. Watch the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically ~9:00 PM). Enjoy the Main Street Electrical Parade if running. Ride favorites again with shorter evening wait times before park close.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before shuttle departure – or grab a quick bite at Main Street Bakery (Starbucks partner) inside Magic Kingdom upon arrival
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom) – Premium prix-fixe lunch in the enchanted Beast's Castle; reserve via Disney dining reservations well in advance
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table – Iconic fine-dining inside Cinderella Castle with character meet-and-greets; prix-fixe menu featuring premium American cuisine; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and individual Lightning Lane selections through the My Disney Experience app first thing in the morning. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a portable fan, and a refillable water bottle. The free hotel shuttle typically runs on a schedule – confirm times the night before.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (opens ~9:00 AM). Begin in Future World/World Discovery: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane) and Test Track. Head to World Nature for Soarin' Around the World with stunning aerial cinematography. Arrive at World Showcase as it opens (~11:00 AM) and begin exploring pavilions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase experience – Stroll through Mexico (ride Gran Fiesta Tour), Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France (Remy's Ratatouille Adventure), United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisines and artisan goods at each pavilion. Participate in any cultural demonstrations or live entertainment on the World Showcase stage.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon – one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Enjoy a leisurely dinner at a World Showcase restaurant before the show. Return to hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: The Wave… of American Flavors at Disney's Contemporary Resort (short drive/monorail) – farm-to-table breakfast with organic options; or hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Chefs de France (France Pavilion, EPCOT) – Authentic French brasserie cuisine with crepes, croque monsieurs, and classic French entrées in an elegant setting
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion, EPCOT) – Premium teppanyaki dining experience with skilled chefs preparing Wagyu beef, lobster, and seasonal Japanese dishes tableside

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive – wear comfortable walking shoes. The World Showcase is best explored at a leisurely pace; don't rush. Book all dining reservations 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience. Consider the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if visiting during that season (typically July–November) for additional culinary experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios (opens ~9:00 AM). Head straight to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Book Savi's Workshop (Build Your Own Lightsaber) – a premium, immersive 20-minute experience ($250+ per lightsaber; book well in advance). Explore the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run attraction. Visit Oga's Cantina for exotic themed beverages (reservations required).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Hollywood Studios – Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most technologically advanced rides; use Lightning Lane). Visit Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Explore the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in Sunset Boulevard. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular if scheduled.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime spectacular at Hollywood Studios – a dramatic water, fire, and projection show featuring Mickey Mouse. Alternatively, catch the 'Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular' fireworks show. Dine at a premium Hollywood Studios restaurant before the evening show. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or grab a quick bite at Trolley Car Café (Starbucks) inside Hollywood Studios at park opening
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant (Hollywood Studios) – Unique drive-in movie theater themed restaurant serving premium burgers, steaks, and milkshakes while watching classic sci-fi film clips
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby (Hollywood Studios) – Iconic fine-dining replica of the legendary Hollywood restaurant; signature Cobb Salad, premium steaks, and fresh seafood in an elegant Art Deco setting

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations are extremely limited and sell out fast – book exactly 60 days in advance at 7:00 AM EST via My Disney Experience or call Disney directly. The Droid Depot (Build Your Own Droid, ~$120) is a great alternative or addition for kids. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute seating limit and requires reservations.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage – Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom (opens ~8:00 AM; early entry available for some guests). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane Single Pass highly recommended – this is the most in-demand ride at Walt Disney World). Explore the bioluminescent Na'vi River Journey boat ride. Walk through the stunning Pandora landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Animal Kingdom – Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari (morning or early afternoon for best wildlife activity). Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and more in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest roller coaster and Kali River Rapids (bring a change of clothes or ponchos). Explore DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Animal Kingdom's 'Rivers of Light' nighttime spectacular (check current schedule as programming may vary). Alternatively, enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show at dusk – a magical free experience. Dine at a premium Animal Kingdom restaurant before heading back to the hotel for a restful evening.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Donald's Safari Breakfast character dining with African-inspired breakfast buffet; meet Donald Duck, Daisy, Mickey, and Goofy in safari attire
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora, Animal Kingdom) – Healthy, flavorful bowls with premium proteins (slow-roasted Rongi beans, wood-grilled chicken, sustainable fish) in a stunning Pandora setting
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Disney's most upscale Animal Kingdom dining; globally inspired fine cuisine celebrating the art of travel; signature dishes include whole-roasted chicken, sustainable fish, and premium desserts; extensive wine and cocktail list

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the Kilimanjaro Safari. Bring insect repellent and sunscreen. Avatar: Flight of Passage is a simulator ride – not suitable for guests with severe motion sickness. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks, so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take the hotel's free shuttle to Disney Springs (no park ticket required). Explore the vibrant waterfront shopping, dining, and entertainment complex. Visit the LEGO Store for an interactive family experience. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world). Check out the Marketplace Co-Op for unique Disney-themed boutiques. Enjoy live street performers and musicians throughout the complex.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Disney Springs – Visit the NBA Experience (interactive basketball activities) or Splitsville Luxury Lanes (upscale bowling and entertainment). Explore the Town Center and The Landing districts. Shop at premium retailers including Kate Spade, Tommy Bahama, and Anthropologie. Visit the Disney PhotoPass Studio for professional family portraits. Enjoy the free outdoor entertainment and waterfront ambiance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a premium dinner at one of Disney Springs' signature restaurants. After dinner, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 (IMAX available) or enjoy live music at one of the entertainment venues. Stroll the illuminated waterfront promenade before returning to the hotel via shuttle for a relaxed evening.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast – take advantage of a leisurely morning start; or visit The Polite Pig (Disney Springs) for a Southern-inspired brunch with craft cocktails
meals.lunch: Wine Bar George (Disney Springs) – Master Sommelier George Miliotes' flagship restaurant; premium charcuterie boards, flatbreads, and small plates paired with an exceptional wine selection
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia (Disney Springs) – Celebrity Chef Masaharu Morimoto's pan-Asian masterpiece; signature dishes include Peking duck, sushi platters, and Wagyu beef; stunning two-story restaurant with dramatic décor; extensive sake and cocktail menu

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and park (self-parking is complimentary for the first 3 hours with validation). This is a great recovery day after intense park days. The Springs is typically less crowded on weekday mornings. Many shops and restaurants open at 10:00 AM. Live entertainment is scattered throughout the day – check the Disney Springs entertainment schedule online.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a favorite park or explore a new experience – Based on the week's highlights, choose a return visit to the most-loved park using any remaining Lightning Lane credits. Alternatively, visit Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park for a refreshing finale (separate ticket required; premium cabana rentals available). Enjoy a leisurely morning with a premium resort breakfast before heading out.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Disney World experiences – If returning to a park, focus on any missed attractions or re-riding favorites. Consider a VIP Tour Guide experience through Disney (private guided park tour, $450–$900/hour, minimum 7 hours) for the ultimate luxury send-off. Visit the resort's pool or spa for relaxation. Begin packing and preparing for departure. Check out of the hotel (standard checkout ~11:00 AM; request late checkout if needed).
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a world-class Orlando restaurant outside Disney property for a change of scenery. Head to Orlando International Airport for departure or extend your stay. Reflect on an unforgettable week of Disney magic with the family.

meals.breakfast: Grand Floridian Café (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort) – Elegant Victorian-style breakfast with eggs Benedict, French toast, and fresh pastries; accessible via Disney monorail from the Transportation & Ticket Center
meals.lunch: Paddlefish (Disney Springs) – Upscale seafood restaurant aboard a stunning multi-deck riverboat; fresh oysters, lobster bisque, and premium seafood entrées with beautiful waterfront views
meals.dinner: The Ravenous Pig (Winter Park, Orlando) – Award-winning James Beard-nominated gastropub; farm-to-table American cuisine with craft cocktails; a beloved local institution for a memorable farewell meal (approx. 25-min drive from hotel)

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout from Ramada to maximize your final day without rushing. Store luggage at the front desk if needed. Confirm return transportation to Orlando International Airport – pre-book a private luxury car or Mears Connect First Class for a stress-free departure. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for airport security and check-in. Don't forget to download all Disney PhotoPass photos before your Memory Maker subscription expires!

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
